feeds.title: Community Care
feeds.description: Community Care is a specialist website dedicated to all areas of the social care profession. Our website is the leading online medium for those working in social care and it contains all of the articles that have been published both in Community Care magazine and online since 1995. Inspiring excellence in social care. Read the latest social work and social care news, opinion and analysis and find your perfect social work or social care job

feeds.title: Social Care Blog
feeds.description: Social care blog from the Department of Health shares news, views and information updates for anyone working in - or receiving support from - the care and support sector.

feeds.title: Scottish Care Blog
feeds.description: We represent the largest group of Health & Social Care sector independent providers across Scotland, delivering residential care, day care, care at home and housing support.

feeds.title: SocialCareToday
feeds.description: Socialcare.today is the UK's online magazine covering Social Care & Health. With daily news and features our respected journalists keep you up to date with what's happening across the sector.

feeds.title: Health & Social Care Workforce Blog
feeds.description: Health & Social Care Workforce is the blog of the NIHR Policy Research Unit in Health and Social Care Workforce at King's College London. Our writing here focuses on workforce issues in the UK health and social care sector.

feeds.title: SWU BLog
feeds.description: SWU works alongside BASW to protect social work professionals speaking as social workers for social workers. Having a professional association and trade union together is important for the social work profession. We aim to be the best trade union for social workers.

feeds.title: Richard Devine Blog
feeds.description: I am a Social Worker for Bath and North East Somerset Council. In 2020 I decided to start a blog. The purpose of this is primarily to have a system in which I commit to a practice of writing in an attempt to facilitate my own learning and development.

feeds.title: The Social Issue
feeds.description: The Social Issue is run by journalist and commissioning editor Saba Salman. It covers people, places and projects making a difference in society, and issues ranging from community to social enterprise, charity, social care, housing and families.

feeds.title: The Masked AMHP
feeds.description: The Masked AMHP is a Approved Mental Health Professional social worker working in a rural England area who tries to explain his work in a variety of interesting and often humorous ways.

feeds.title: Social Work Action Network
feeds.description: Social Work Action Network is a network of social work practitioners, academics, students and social welfare service users united in their concern that social work activity is being undermined by managerialism and marketisation, by the stigmatisation of service users and by welfare cuts and restrictions.

feeds.title: Portman Recruitment Blog
feeds.description: Portman Recruitment keeps you up to date with industry happenings and opportunities for carers and those working in the healthcare industry. An independent recruitment consultancy that specialises in the social work and care sectors. Working with qualified professionals, we continuously and successfully match candidates with their ideal work placements throughout the UK.

feeds.title: Social Work Haven
feeds.description: Hi there! I'm Angy. The creator of Social Work Haven. I am a Social Worker, Practice Educator Mentor, and Best Interests Assessor. I created this motivational and educational blog focused on empowering social workers and providing content about social work, personal development, mental health so that we can increase awareness and have conversations about social work, personal development and mental health.

feeds.title: Social Work London
feeds.description: We are the new look of social work. That's right, cool, professional, fun, and, above all perspicacious. Yes, we will be bringing you guys the best thoughts, ideas, and innovation around. Right to your phone or computer.

feeds.title: BASW
feeds.description: BASW is the only professional association for social workers in the UK, with offices in England, Northern Ireland, Scotland and Wales. We offer a clear voice for the profession and strive to promote the best possible social work services for all people who may need them, while also securing the well-being of social workers.

feeds.title: The Good News
feeds.description: The media is saturated in negative news stories about Social Work. I wanted to create a space where the GOOD that, as a profession, we do can be shared, and hopefully challenge some of this stigma. I feel that our field is driven by a a desire to help and support, but the legacy of oppression and power has made it an uphill battle to do the work that we so want to do.

feeds.title: Martin Webber
feeds.description: I am a Professor of Social Work at the University of York. This blog arises from my work and my reflections on it. One of its aims is to help to bridge the gap between the academic and practical fields of social work. My main interest is in developing the evidence base for social work to help practitioners become more effective in their work and improve outcomes for the people they serve.
